firstYear: First year is mostly mathematics and data: Mathematics 1A and 1B, discrete maths, foundations of data science and data computing, plus a unit on research and communication in the mathematical sciences. Most of these have Advanced versions. You then choose a major from Mathematics, Statistics, Financial Mathematics and Statistics, Data Science, Mathematical Modelling and Computation, or Discrete Mathematics and Algorithms, and add a minor or second major.
notThis: Not a general science degree. In a Bachelor of Science, maths is one choice among many sciences; here every major is mathematical, and the university describes the degree as a foundation for Honours. It takes three years.
